disclosures.title: OpenAI Codex
disclosures.text: Signing in with ChatGPT uses the sign-in OpenAI built for its Codex tool. OpenAI hasn't approved Khaos to use it, so it may change or stop working without notice, and your ChatGPT plan's usage limits apply.
